units.source_text: 不久大家睡静了。

en.t: Before long, everyone had fallen asleep and the house was quiet.

units.source_text: 源氏公子试把纸隔扇上的钩子打开，觉得那面没有上钩。

en.t: Prince Genji tried opening the hook on the paper sliding partition and realized that the other side was not fastened.

units.source_text: 他悄悄地把纸隔扇拉开，但见入口处立着帷屏，灯光暗淡，室中零乱地放着些柜子之类的器具。

en.t: He quietly slid the paper partition open and saw a curtain screen standing by the entrance, the lamplight dim, and cabinets and other furnishings scattered about the room.

units.source_text: 他就从这些器具之间走进室内，走到这女子所在的地方，但见她独自睡着，身材很小巧。

en.t: He went into the room through the spaces between those furnishings and came to where the woman was, finding her asleep alone and very slight in build.

units.source_text: 他觉得有些不好意思，终于伸手把她盖着的衣服拉开。

en.t: Feeling somewhat embarrassed, he finally reached out and drew aside the clothing that covered her.

units.source_text: 这空蝉只当是她刚才叫的那个侍女中将回来了，却听见源氏公子说：“刚才你叫中将，我正是近卫中将[\[29\]](#part1331.html#m29)，想来你了解我私下爱慕你的一片心吧。……”

en.t: Utsusemi thought the maid Chujo, whom she had just called, had returned, but then she heard Prince Genji say, "You called for Chujo just now; I am in fact a lieutenant of the guards, and surely you understand the heart that has secretly loved you."

units.source_text: 空蝉吓了一跳，不知如何是好，疑心自己着了梦魔，惊慌得“呀”地叫了一声。

en.t: Utsusemi started in terror, not knowing what to do, and, suspecting she was caught by a nightmare spirit, cried out in panic.

units.source_text: 她用衣袖遮着自己的脸，说不出话来。

en.t: She covered her face with her sleeve and could not speak.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对她说道：“太唐突了，你道我是浮薄浪子一时冲动，确也难怪。

en.t: Prince Genji said to her, "This is terribly sudden, and I cannot blame you if you think I am a frivolous libertine acting on a momentary impulse.

units.source_text: 其实我私心倾慕，已历多年；常想和你罄吐衷曲，苦无机会。

en.t: In truth, I have admired you in secret for many years, and I have often wished to pour out my heart to you, but I had no chance.

units.source_text: 今宵幸得邂逅，因缘非浅。

en.t: Tonight I have fortunately been able to meet you, and the bond between us must be deep.

units.source_text: 万望曲谅愚诚，幸赐青睐！”

en.t: I beg you to kindly understand my foolish sincerity and grant me your favor."

units.source_text: 说得婉转温顺，魔鬼听了也会软化，何况他是个容姿秀丽、光彩焕发的美男子。

en.t: He spoke so gently and gracefully that even a demon would have softened on hearing him, and all the more so because he was a beautiful man with radiant good looks.

units.source_text: 那空蝉神魂恍惚。

en.t: Utsusemi was dazed, as if her spirit had left her.

units.source_text: 想喊“这里来了陌生人”，也喊不出口。

en.t: She wanted to cry out, "A stranger has come in here," but no voice would come.

units.source_text: 只觉得心慌意乱，想起了这非礼之事，更是惊恐万状；喘着气低声说道：“你认错了人吧？”

en.t: She felt only panic and confusion, and when she thought of the impropriety of what was happening, she became even more terrified; gasping, she whispered, "You must have mistaken me for someone else."

units.source_text: 她那恹恹欲绝的神色，教人又是可怜，又是可爱。

en.t: Her faint, nearly collapsing expression made her seem both pitiable and lovely.

units.source_text: 源氏公子答道：“并不认错人，情之所钟，自然认识。

en.t: Prince Genji replied, "I have not mistaken you. When the heart is fixed on someone, it naturally knows her.

units.source_text: 请勿佯装不知。

en.t: Please do not pretend not to know.

units.source_text: 我决不是轻薄少年，只是想向你谈谈我的心事。”

en.t: I am certainly not a frivolous young man; I only wish to speak to you about what is in my heart."

units.source_text: 这人身材小巧，公子便抱了她，走向纸隔扇去。

en.t: Because she was so small, the prince took her in his arms and went toward the paper sliding partition.

units.source_text: 恰巧这时候，刚才她叫的那个侍女中将进来了。

en.t: Just then, the maid Chujo whom she had called earlier came in.

units.source_text: 源氏公子叫道：“喂，喂！”

en.t: Prince Genji called out, "Hey, hey!"

units.source_text: 这中将弄得莫名其妙，暗中摸索过来，但觉一阵阵的香气，直扑到她脸上，便心知是源氏公子了。

en.t: Chujo was bewildered and groped toward them in the dark, but when waves of fragrance struck her face, she knew at once that it was Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 中将大吃一惊，不知道这是怎么一回事，说不出话来。

en.t: Chujo was deeply shocked, unable to understand what was happening and unable to speak.

units.source_text: 她想：“若是别人，我便叫喊起来，把人夺回。

en.t: She thought, "If it were anyone else, I would cry out and take her back.

units.source_text: 然而势必弄得尽人皆知，也不是道理。

en.t: But that would certainly make everyone know about it, and that would not be proper either.

units.source_text: 何况这是源氏公子。

en.t: Besides, this is Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 怎么办呢？”

en.t: What am I to do?"

units.source_text: 她心中犹豫不决，只管跟着走来。

en.t: Still wavering in her heart, she simply followed along.

units.source_text: 源氏公子却若无其事，一直走进自己房间里去了。

en.t: Prince Genji, however, acted as if nothing were amiss and went straight into his own room.

units.source_text: 拉上纸隔扇时，他对中将说：“天亮的时候你来迎接她吧！”

en.t: As he pulled the paper partition shut, he said to Chujo, "Come to fetch her when day breaks."
